name: artefact_rubble
subject: a chunky grey fieldstone, roughly hewn, sitting on the ground
detail: One hero object, centred. Irregular angular stone with a couple of chips. Two tones of grey plus a dark outline. The silhouette must read as 'rough stone'.

name: artefact_clay
subject: a small hand-thrown clay pot with a narrow neck and a round belly
detail: One hero object, centred. A simple vessel shape. Warm terracotta with a lighter highlight band on one side and a dark outline. The silhouette must read as 'pot'.

name: artefact_relic
subject: a small carved stone brooch or idol face with two eyes
detail: One hero object, centred. A roughly carved face or brooch shape. Cool grey-green stone with two darker eye pixels. The silhouette must read as 'carved face'.

name: artefact_crown
subject: a small ancient gold crown or torc with three points
detail: One hero object, centred. Three distinct points, a band across the bottom, a jewel pixel in the centre. Warm gold with a bright highlight. The silhouette must read as 'crown'.

name: dig_site
subject: an archaeological dig site: a rectangular pit of dark earth with a spoil heap beside it
detail: A small scene, not a single object. The pit is a dark open rectangle seen slightly from above, with a mound of lighter dug earth beside it and a tiny wooden marker stake. Keep it to 3 distinct shapes.

name: curator
subject: a small friendly curator fairy, the size of a hand, wearing a tiny coat and holding a magnifier
detail: One character, centred, facing the viewer. A tiny figure with a distinct head, body and a magnifier held to one side. Gaps between head and body so the silhouette reads.

name: gallery_case
subject: an empty museum display case: a wooden base, a glass box and a small brass label plate
detail: One object, centred. A rectangular base, a transparent-looking box drawn as a light outline only, and a tiny plaque. Leave the middle EMPTY - the case holds artefacts later.

name: reel_wheel
subject: a wooden fortune-teller wheel with six spokes and a small brass hub
detail: One object, centred, seen face-on. A ring with six spokes radiating from a small hub. The ring and spokes are separate shapes with gaps between them.
